  "overall_experience": "The Managing Director likely found Basecamp to be a valuable tool for centralizing client communications and project status within their small hospitality business. Its integrated approach to tasks, discussions, and file sharing helped streamline operations and reduce reliance on multiple platforms. However, they may have found its feature set somewhat basic for more complex project management needs and occasionally struggled with notification management or finding older information."
